title: Live roadmap plan
description: The hand-kept plan read by tools/roadmap/build.mjs. The builder also checks what this schema cannot: ids that refer to each other, a text for every language, loops in "after", and the curating rules.

languages.description: Languages of every text, the first is the default. With one language texts are plain strings; with several, each text is an object keyed by language.

output.description: Page folder, relative to the repository root (may lie outside it).

watch.description: The project's own plan or status documents. When one changes after this plan, the check warns.

trunk.description: Id of the track every other track branches off and rejoins. It holds the final milestone.

notOnRoadmap.description: History keys deliberately on no milestone (tooling, docs, chores): a branch name, "#42", or a pattern with * that matches a key or the commit subject ("dependabot/*", "chore*").

tracks.description: 4-10 topics a non-technical reader recognises, listed top to bottom as drawn, the trunk near the middle.

milestones.description: Outcomes, not tasks: 3-8 per track, in the order they happen.

waiting.description: Decisions only a human can make that block work.

text.description: One sentence: what must be decided.

milestone.description: Id of the milestone it blocks.

text.description: A plain string with one language; an object keyed by language with several.

historyKey.description: A branch name ("feature/login") or a pull request ("#42").

track.description: A track id. A track's milestones are in listed order.

status.description: done: finished, with evidence. active: being worked on now (at most 3). next: directly queued after the active work. later: everything else up to the release.

title.description: A short outcome, 2-5 words, at most 30 characters.

summary.description: One plain sentence on what a user gets.

after.description: Ids of milestones in other tracks this one waits for (a track's own order is implicit). The first is where a track branches off.

merge.description: History keys that finish it. Required evidence for done; on a milestone not done yet, the keys it expects (it shows as done once all of them are merged).

commit.description: Done only: a commit hash, for work that never went through a merge.

ref.description: Short internal reference shown small (ticket, work package, phase).

tasks.description: The checklist on its card; an active milestone has 3-7.

final.description: Exactly one milestone: the release every track ends in.
